aboutpara: I'm Dimuthu Wickramanayake, an engineer in Singapore working on AI platforms and agent infrastructure, with 7+ years running production systems on GCP and AWS. Most of my recent work is about making LLMs safe to point at real infrastructure: two Model Context Protocol servers my colleagues use daily for incident triage and data questions, and an internal assistant serving 50+ people with fail-closed data isolation and approval-gated writes. Underneath that sits the ordinary, unglamorous platform work that makes it possible — Kubernetes services holding 3,000+ RPS for 50M+ users, a multi-terabyte BigQuery platform, and CI/CD you can audit. I also publish open source, including Limbiq (an adaptive AI memory layer on PyPI), PII Guard (a Rust privacy proxy for LLMs), and platform-mcp.

resume.description: AI platform engineer with 7+ years operating production systems on GCP and AWS. I ship LLM infrastructure that an engineering team depends on daily — two Model Context Protocol servers used in production by 10+ engineers, and a 50-user LangGraph assistant hardened with fail-closed data isolation, approval-gated writes, and quota-aware concurrency control. Underneath sits consumer-scale platform work: Kubernetes services sustaining 3,000+ RPS for 50M+ users, and a 35% quarter-over-quarter cut in critical incidents.
